traits.description: Everything runs fast inside you. Every 10 in-game minutes, hunger increases by +0.05 and thirst increases by +0.03.
traits.name: Accelerated Metabolism

traits.description: Heights make your stomach drop and your hands shake. The higher up you are, the harder it is to function.
traits.name: Acrophobic

traits.description: You fight like the hero of your own action movie. With at least 3 living enemies within 10 tiles, equipped weapons gain 15 percentage points of critical chance, up to 100 percent. Checked every 30 player updates. Disabled by Mundane.
traits.name: Action Hero

traits.description: Your body draws on stored calories before signaling hunger. While you have positive caloric reserves, passive hunger cannot drop your meter below roughly 99 percent full. Eating still works normally. Once caloric reserves are depleted, hunger advances unmodified and you can starve.
traits.name: Adaptive Metabolism

traits.description: Without recent caffeine, stress increases by +0.06 every 10 in-game minutes. Consuming caffeine prevents the next increase.
traits.name: Caffeine Addict

traits.description: Sunlight wears you down. Every minute spent outdoors from 06:00 through 17:59 adds 0.03 stress and 0.02 fatigue, up to each meter's maximum.
traits.name: Albino

traits.description: While intoxication is below 5, stress increases by +0.05 every 30 in-game minutes.
traits.name: Alcoholic I

traits.description: While intoxication is below 5, stress increases by +0.10 every 10 in-game minutes.
traits.name: Alcoholic II

traits.description: While intoxication is below 10, stress increases by +0.05 every in-game minute; below 5, panic also increases by +3.
traits.name: Alcoholic III

traits.description: Your body reacts badly to things that others tolerate fine. Food allergies can turn a meal into a medical event.
traits.name: Allergic

traits.description: Weekend electrical projects taught you more than most people know. +1 to Electrical.
traits.name: Amateur Electrician

traits.description: You feel no pain. All pain is permanently suppressed regardless of injuries.
traits.name: Analgesia

traits.description: Low iron levels slow your healing. Wound bleed decay is 3× slower (wounds close much slower than normal).
traits.name: Anemic

traits.description: Your relationship with food is deeply complicated. Each time you eat, stress increases by 0.10 (10 percent of the stress meter).
traits.name: Anorexia

traits.description: You spent years campaigning against firearms and never touched one. XP gain in Aiming and Reloading is reduced to ×0.5 (-50 percent).
traits.name: Anti-Gun Activist

traits.description: Your eye for rare and exceptional craftsmanship gives you a chance to find antique weapons and clothing hidden in crates and metal shelves. These items are significantly better than anything else you can find. Roughly 0.8 percent chance per eligible container, once per loot cycle.
traits.name: Antique Enthusiast

traits.description: Your distrust of medicine makes you resistant to treatment. Medical items are less effective on you.
traits.name: Anti-Vaxxer

traits.description: You subsist on the bare minimum. Eating within 1 hour of your last meal triggers a mood penalty (+10 unhappiness, +5 stress). Passive benefit: hunger builds up ~15 percent more slowly - your body needs less food.
traits.name: Ascetic

traits.description: +2 to Axe. All axe attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Axe Fighter

traits.description: Efficient packing and load distribution let you carry more comfortably. Carry weight is increased.
traits.name: Backpacker

traits.description: Dental problems make eating painful. Eating causes increasing head pain (proportional to food healing). Food effectiveness is not reduced - it just hurts.
traits.name: Bad Teeth

traits.description: You're a human freight train. While running or sprinting, entering collision range knocks each new nearby zombie down and drains endurance. Running drains 0.05 endurance; sprinting drains 0.03 and deals 0.15 impact damage. Martial Artist also applies its normal bonus damage. This does not prevent the game's normal trip or stagger.
traits.name: Battering Ram

traits.description: You are never big enough, never strong enough, never enough. Your mood suffers whenever your body does not match the image in your head.
traits.name: Bigorexia

traits.description: Sharp steel is your answer to the undead. +2 to Long Blade and Short Blade.
traits.name: Blade Fighter

traits.description: +1 to Long Blade and Small Blade.
traits.name: Blade Twirl

traits.description: +1 to Fitness. Passively gain happiness over time.
traits.name: Blissfully Fit

traits.description: You trust a solid bludgeon over any blade. +2 to Long Blunt and Short Blunt.
traits.name: Blunt Fighter

traits.description: +1 to Small Blunt and Blunt.
traits.name: Blunt Twirl

traits.description: Years of handling rough crowds taught you to roll with the punches. The next new injury you take after the cooldown is automatically downgraded to a lesser one (bite to laceration, laceration to scratch, fracture halved). 300-second base cooldown, reduced by 10 seconds per Strength level. Will not cure a pre-existing zombie infection.
traits.name: Bouncer I

traits.description: You have been hit so many times nothing fazes you. The next new injury you take after the cooldown is automatically downgraded to a lesser one (bite to laceration, laceration to scratch, fracture halved). 220-second base cooldown, reduced by 20 seconds per Strength level. Will not cure a pre-existing zombie infection.
traits.name: Bouncer II

traits.description: Your bones are fragile and snap under stress. Fracture chance is increased by +50%.
traits.name: Brittle

traits.description: Your leg snapped before you even got started. You spawn with a fractured and injured left foot, stress at 0.5, and fatigue at 0.3.
traits.name: Broken

traits.description: Fire got to you before you got away. You spawn with 60 percent burn severity on your upper torso and both hands, stress at 0.7, fatigue at 0.5, and panic at 0.3.
traits.name: Burned

traits.description: Things slip out of your hands at the worst moments. No matter how careful you try to be, stuff just ends up on the floor.
traits.name: Butterfingers

traits.description: Your base carry weight is reduced by 1.
traits.name: Weak Grip

traits.description: Your base carry weight is increased by 1.
traits.name: Strong Grip

traits.description: +1 to Long Blade skill. Long blade attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Cleaver

traits.description: Cold cuts through you faster than it should. Even mild temperature drops affect your body and your focus.
traits.name: Cold Sensitive

traits.description: You eat with purpose and efficiency. Each time you eat, boredom decreases by 10 points and hunger decreases by 0.05 (5 percent of the hunger meter).
traits.name: Competitive Eater

traits.description: You feel most at ease indoors. While inside, boredom and unhappiness slowly decrease.
traits.name: Homebody

traits.description: Your hands know how to make something from nothing. +1 to Carpentry, Mechanics, and Tailoring.
traits.name: Crafty

traits.description: You strike without mercy or hesitation. Start at level 1 in every melee weapon skill.
traits.name: Cruelty

traits.description: A heavy sadness follows you everywhere. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress increases by +0.08.
traits.name: Depressive

traits.description: Years of neglect have left your body in poor condition. Multiple physical stats are reduced.
traits.name: Deprived

traits.description: Countless hours behind the wheel have made you a natural. Improves vehicle top speed, engine power, and braking by 20 percent, and makes the engine 20 percent quieter.
traits.name: Driver

traits.description: You treat your gear with care and know how to make it last. Items you use degrade 25 percent slower (durability multiplier: ×1.25).
traits.name: Durability

traits.description: +1 to Nimble and Sprinting. 50 percent chance to completely dodge incoming damage.
traits.name: Evasive

traits.description: Years behind the wheel have made you one of the best. Improves vehicle handling while driving.
traits.name: Expert Driver

traits.description: +30 percent movement speed. Also slowly regenerates endurance (+0.01 per 30 ticks) while endurance is not full.
traits.name: Fast

traits.description: Your hands move with fluid precision. Item transfers and reload actions complete 40 percent faster (transfer time multiplier: ×0.6).
traits.name: Fast Hands

traits.description: Fear comes quickly and hits hard. Each time a panic event fires, panic is increased by an additional +0.2.
traits.name: Fearful

traits.description: Darkness is not just inconvenient for you, it is genuinely frightening. Being in the dark wears away at your composure.
traits.name: Fear of the Dark

traits.description: Chronic pain is your constant companion. Everyday exertion costs more than it should, and bad days can be genuinely debilitating.
traits.name: Fibromyalgia

traits.description: Reduces the weight of each worn clothing item by 50%. Removes run and combat speed penalties from worn items. Effect updates every ~1 second.
traits.name: Fitted

traits.description: Your swings are wild and undisciplined. Combat accuracy is reduced by -15%. While panicking and running, you may stumble and fall.
traits.name: Flailer

traits.description: You distrust books, science, and anything written down. Reading speed is reduced by 30 percent and MetaGame XP is reduced to ×0.7 (-30 percent).
traits.name: Flat Earther

traits.description: +1 to Nimble.
traits.name: Flexible

traits.description: You are not built for physical exertion. Strength and endurance are reduced.
traits.name: Flimsy

traits.description: You kept the lights on when the grid failed. +1 to Electrical.
traits.name: Generator Know-How

traits.description: An old injury slows you down. -50 percent movement speed.
traits.name: Gimp

traits.description: Your body feels like it was built to break. All incoming damage is multiplied by ×1.5 (+50 percent damage taken).
traits.name: Glass Body

traits.description: +2 to Cooking. Food you cook provides 50 percent more nutrition and calories.
traits.name: Gordanite

traits.description: Food is one of life's great pleasures. Each meal grants +50 percent bonus hunger relief and reduces boredom and unhappiness by the same proportion.
traits.name: Gourmand

traits.description: +2 to Plant Scavenging.
traits.name: Grave Robber

traits.description: Raw power and aggression drive your fighting style. +1 to Carpentry, Short Blunt, Masonry, and Blacksmith.
traits.name: Grunt

traits.description: You have a knack for firearms. +1 to Aiming and Reloading.
traits.name: Gun Specialist I

traits.description: You handle firearms with practiced efficiency. +2 to Aiming and Reloading, +1 to Nimbleness.
traits.name: Gun Specialist II

traits.description: You are a firearms expert. +2 to Aiming and Reloading, +1 to Nimbleness. Reload and aim times are reduced by 10%. Equipped firearms never jam.
traits.name: Gun Specialist III

traits.description: +1 to Strength and Fitness.
traits.name: Gym-Goer

traits.description: You endure. When fatigue exceeds 0.8 an exhaustion phase begins, raising stress by +0.02 per minute. After 10 consecutive minutes of rest (fatigue below 0.3), exhaustion clears and a 5-minute bonus phase begins that slowly restores endurance (+0.002 per minute).
traits.name: Hardy

traits.description: Heat hits you harder than most. High temperatures sap your strength and leave you struggling when others are merely warm.
traits.name: Heat Sensitive

traits.description: Even minor cuts refuse to close. Bleed rate is increased to 200 percent of normal - wounds bleed twice as fast.
traits.name: Heavily Bleeding Wounds

traits.description: You put your whole body into every blow. +2 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, Short Blade, Short Blunt, and Spear.
traits.name: Heavy Swing

traits.description: You sweat profusely at the slightest exertion. Physical activity rapidly increases your wetness level.
traits.name: High Sweaty

traits.description: Carry 2 more weight. If your inventory is below 80% full or you are not wearing an inventory container, craving builds each minute and adds 0.02/0.04/0.08 stress per minute after 10/30/60 minutes.
traits.name: Human Hamster

traits.description: You are in peak physical condition. Carry weight is increased by +1 and fatigue rate is reduced to 85 percent of normal.
traits.name: Ideal Weight

traits.description: Every 10 in-game minutes, zombie infection is reduced by 3, to a minimum of 0, and fatigue is reduced by 0.02.
traits.name: Immune Response

traits.description: Every in-game minute, existing zombie infection increases by 1, up to a maximum of 100.
traits.name: Immunocompromised

traits.description: +1 to Maintenance skill. Equipped weapons degrade 50 percent slower.
traits.name: Improviser

traits.description: Complex ideas just do not stick for you. Your effective skill cap is reduced by 2 in all skills.
traits.name: Incomprehensive

traits.description: You do not know the meaning of worn out. While running, endurance slowly regenerates (+0.005 per 30 ticks). When endurance bottoms out, a 3-minute recovery timer starts and restores endurance to 50 percent on completion.
traits.name: Indefatigable

traits.description: You find creative solutions where others see dead ends. +2 to Electrical and +1 to Metalworking.
traits.name: Ingenuitive

traits.description: You start with injuries to your left hand and left foot, and stress at 0.3.
traits.name: Injured I

traits.description: You start with injuries to both hands, your left foot, and upper torso, with stress at 0.6 and fatigue at 0.4.
traits.name: Injured II

traits.description: Alcohol affects you about as much as water. Each real-world minute, drunkenness above 0.1 is reduced by 10 percent (multiplied by ×0.9).
traits.name: Iron Liver

traits.description: You rise with the sun and hit the ground running. Between 6am and 6pm stress decreases by 0.02 per minute. Between 6pm and 6am stress increases by 0.02 per minute. Net effect over a full day is zero - purely a lifestyle trait.
traits.name: Early Bird

traits.description: You always pushed vehicles past their limits. +20 percent vehicle top speed while driving.
traits.name: Lead Foot

traits.description: You run cooler than most. Every in-game minute while awake, wetness is reduced by 3 indoors, 1.5 outdoors, and 0.5 in rain. If body temperature rises above 37.2 C, it cools by 0.08 C per minute, or 0.12 C above 37.7 C. This gives strong heat resistance under normal conditions, but does not make you heat-immune.
traits.name: Less Sweaty

traits.description: +2 to Long Blade. Long blade attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Long Blade

traits.description: +2 to Blunt. Long blunt weapon attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Long Blunt

traits.description: Technology has always been your enemy. XP gain in Electrical is reduced to ×0.6 (-40 percent).
traits.name: Luddite

traits.description: You move with a lumbering, uncoordinated gait. -15 percent movement speed and +15 percent longer work duration (actions take longer). When exhausted and moving, you may lose your footing.
traits.name: Lurcher

traits.description: Combat wakes something up in you. Each time you kill a zombie, stress decreases by -0.15 and boredom decreases by -0.2.
traits.name: Maniac

traits.description: +2 to Sprinting. Fatigue and endurance drain reduced by 15%.
traits.name: Marathon Runner

traits.description: Your hands are lethal weapons. Each bare-hand hit spends 0.001 endurance and adds damage scaled by Short Blunt and pre-drain endurance. Normal bonus damage is 0.5 plus 0.05 per level; critical bonus damage is 3.0 plus 0.3 per level. Critical chance is 5 percent plus 8 percentage points per level. The damage multiplier is pre-drain endurance plus 0.35. Each hit grants Short Blunt experience equal to twice the bonus damage. Mundane disables the bonus.
traits.name: Martial Artist

traits.description: The world feels muted and grey. A quiet sadness colors everything you do.
traits.name: Melancholic

traits.description: Vehicles do not agree with you. Even short drives leave you nauseous and desperate for still ground.
traits.name: Motion Sickness

traits.description: Even at the end of the world, you find something to be glad about. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress decreases by -0.08 when stress is above 0.6, or -0.03 otherwise.
traits.name: Silver Lining

traits.description: You were never exceptional at anything. XP gain in Carpentry, Cooking, First Aid, Mechanics, Electrical, Aiming, and Reloading is reduced to ×0.8 (-20 percent). Also disables special combat abilities from other traits (Martial Artist, Action Hero).
traits.name: Mundane

traits.description: You know your fungi - the edible, the medicinal, and the deadly. +2 to Foraging.
traits.name: Mushroomer

traits.description: +1 to Cooking skill. Movement speed +10 percent, reduced by 2 percent per clothing item worn (minimum 0 percent; bonus cannot go negative).
traits.name: Natural

traits.description: Your nerves are always close to the edge. Each panic event adds +0.3 to panic. Additionally, every 10 in-game minutes while stress is above 0.7, panic increases by +0.05.
traits.name: Nervous Wreck

traits.description: You trained in the art of silent movement. +2 to Sneaking and +1 to Lightfooted.
traits.name: Ninja Way

traits.description: Your legs never quite cooperate. -20 percent movement speed and constant endurance drain (-0.005/sec).
traits.name: Noodle Legs

traits.description: You'll never get any better with axes. Disables XP gain in Axe.
traits.name: No XP: Axe

traits.description: You know medicine as well as you ever will. First Aid actions grant no XP.
traits.name: No XP: First Aid

traits.description: Tool upkeep is routine. Maintenance grants no XP.
traits.name: No XP: Maintenance

traits.description: You have already mastered firearms and no longer learn from using them. Aiming and Reloading grant no XP.
traits.name: No XP: Shooting

traits.description: You will never improve at moving silently, no matter how much you practice. Disables XP gain in Sneaking and Lightfoot.
traits.name: No XP: Sneaky

traits.description: Electrical work holds no more lessons for you. Electrical and Mechanics grant no XP.
traits.name: No XP: Tech

traits.description: +1 to Sprinting and Fitness. Fatigue and endurance drain reduced by 15%.
traits.name: Olympian

traits.description: You fight best with one hand free. +2 to Short Blade and Short Blunt.
traits.name: One-Handed

traits.description: +1 to Axe. One-handed axe attacks have +5 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: One-Handed Axe

traits.description: +2 to Small Blade. One-handed blade attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: One-Handed Blade

traits.description: +2 to Small Blunt. One-handed blunt weapon attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: One-Handed Blunt

traits.description: You excel only in what you know best. Training multiple skills simultaneously applies an XP penalty across all skills being trained.
traits.name: One Trick Pony

traits.description: You genuinely believe things will work out. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress decreases by -0.06 and panic decreases by -0.04.
traits.name: Optimist

traits.description: You come alive after dark. Every minute from 18:00 through 05:59 reduces stress by 0.02, down to 0. Every minute from 06:00 through 17:59 increases stress by 0.02, up to 1. The two 12-hour windows use equal and opposite rates. The effect does not depend on sleep or location.
traits.name: Night Owl

traits.description: You have always had a brisk, purposeful walk. +15 percent movement speed. After ~20 seconds indoors, you become restless (+2 unhappiness per cycle).
traits.name: Pacer

traits.description: You struggle to carry as much as most people. -2 base carry weight.
traits.name: Pack Mouse

traits.description: You can haul far more than the average survivor. +6 base carry weight.
traits.name: Pack Mule

traits.description: Without warning, your body convinces itself that death is seconds away. The attacks pass, but they leave you shaken.
traits.name: Panic Attacks

traits.description: +2 to Doctor. Medical treatments (bandaging, stitching) are applied 50 percent faster.
traits.name: Paramedic

traits.description: Every shadow hides something. Every 10 in-game minutes, panic increases by +0.06.
traits.name: Paranoia

traits.description: You expect the worst and, frankly, you are usually right. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress increases by +0.05.
traits.name: Pessimist

traits.description: You learn everything faster. All XP gain is increased to ×1.5 (+50 percent). Reading is 3× faster. While reading, panic and stress are forced to 0 and boredom/unhappiness drop rapidly. Finishing a skill book grants a flat XP bonus by tier: +12 / +30 / +65 / +120 / +200.
traits.name: Photographic Memory

traits.description: You have always pushed your body and it pays off. Exercise yields more fitness gains for you than it does for others.
traits.name: Physically Active

traits.description: Medicine that helps others can hurt you. Certain pills trigger an adverse reaction instead of the relief they promise.
traits.name: Pill Allergy

traits.description: +2 to Mechanics. Vehicle repair and maintenance actions are 50 percent faster.
traits.name: Pit Crew

traits.description: You never quite got the hang of driving. Worsens vehicle handling while driving.
traits.name: Student Driver

traits.description: You stockpiled ammunition and reloaded your own rounds. +1 to Aiming and Reloading.
traits.name: Prepared: Ammunition

traits.description: You lived off the land long before the outbreak. +1 to Fishing and Trapping.
traits.name: Prepared: Camping

traits.description: You fortified and reinforced your home long before the dead rose. +1 to Carpentry.
traits.name: Prepared: Carpentry

traits.description: You kept your vehicles in top condition and knew basic mechanics. +1 to Mechanics.
traits.name: Prepared: Vehicles

traits.description: You spent countless hours preserving and preparing food before the outbreak. +1 to Cooking.
traits.name: Prepared: Food

traits.description: You took first-aid courses and kept a well-stocked medical kit. +1 to First Aid.
traits.name: Prepared: Medical

traits.description: You packed your bag with obsessive care before everything fell apart. Increases your base carry weight by +3.
traits.name: Prepared: Pack

traits.description: You kept your gear in fighting shape. +1 to Maintenance.
traits.name: Prepared: Weapons

traits.description: Specialised training with bladed weapons. +2 to Long Blade and Short Blade.
traits.name: Pro: Blade

traits.description: Specialised training with blunt weapons. +2 to Long Blunt and Short Blunt.
traits.name: Pro: Blunt

traits.description: You pick up new skills at an extraordinary rate. Start at level 1 in Cooking, Carpentry, Mechanics, First Aid, Fitness, Sprinting, Tailoring, Electrical, Aiming, and Reloading.
traits.name: Prodigy

traits.description: Specialised firearms training. +2 to Aiming and Reloading.
traits.name: Pro: Firearms

traits.description: +2 to Spear. Spear attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Pro: Spear

traits.description: Your body bounces back from exhaustion fast. Sleep quality is increased by +30%.
traits.name: Quick Rest

traits.description: You always got the job done ahead of schedule. +30 percent work speed on all crafting and building actions.
traits.name: Quick Worker

traits.description: You naturally move without making noise. +1 to Sneaking and Lightfooted.
traits.name: Quiet

traits.description: Your appetite is relentless. Every 10 in-game minutes, hunger increases by +0.1.
traits.name: Ravenous

traits.description: You drop into a deep sleep the moment your head hits the pillow. Sleep quality is increased by +50 percent, allowing faster fatigue recovery from rest.
traits.name: Restful Sleeper

traits.description: You startle easily and panic often. When panic rises by at least 5 points between one-minute checks, 15 additional panic points are added. When at least 9 living zombies are spotted, each eligible player update has a 3 percent chance to make you scream and attract attention. After a scream, this chance pauses for 120 player updates.
traits.name: Scaredy Cat

traits.description: You see value in broken machinery and scrap. Start at Metalworking level 1, Maintenance level 1, and Blacksmithing level 1.
traits.name: Scrapper

traits.description: +1 to Plant Scavenging. When opening a container for the first time, 30 percent chance to find an additional item.
traits.name: Scrounger

traits.description: Just when you think you are done, something kicks in. While sprinting with endurance at or below 0.1, endurance is instantly restored by +0.3. This triggers once per 10-minute cooldown.
traits.name: Second Wind

traits.description: Your body has grown accustomed to doing as little as possible. Fitness fades faster for you without consistent effort.
traits.name: Sedentary

traits.description: You have always been your own worst enemy. You act against your own interests in ways that are hard to explain, even to yourself.
traits.name: Self-Destructive

traits.description: Your digestive system does not take kindly to stress or poor food. Meals that others handle fine can leave you miserable.
traits.name: Sensitive Stomach

traits.description: +2 to Aiming. Equipped firearms have 25 percent more hit chance and effective range.
traits.name: Sharpshooter

traits.description: +2 to Small Blade. Small Blade weapons have +10 critical-chance points, and primary-hand attacks with them have 50 percent lower melee delay.
traits.name: Short Blade

traits.description: +2 to Small Blunt. Short blunt weapon attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Short Blunt

traits.description: Effort was never really your thing. +40 percent work duration on all crafting and building actions (actions take 40 percent longer).
traits.name: Slack

traits.description: Extreme laziness has kept you from developing any physical fitness. Fitness is at its lowest.
traits.name: Sloth

traits.description: You take your sweet time with everything. -50 percent work speed on all crafting and building actions (+50 percent work duration).
traits.name: Slow Worker

traits.description: You rattle the walls when you sleep. Noise output while sleeping is doubled (×2.0 noise multiplier), attracting nearby zombies.
traits.name: Snorer

traits.description: Persistent muscle soreness limits your physical performance. Endurance and strength are reduced.
traits.name: Chronically Sore

traits.description: Your legs are weak and prone to fatigue. -20 percent movement speed and -2 base carry weight.
traits.name: Sore Legs

traits.description: You keep the dead at arm's length with a well-placed thrust. +2 to Spear.
traits.name: Spear Fighter

traits.description: A dedicated medical professional. Start at First Aid level 9.
traits.name: Specialist: First Aid

traits.description: Your life revolved around making and building things. +4 to Carpentry, Metalworking, Masonry, Tailoring, and Electrical. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.
traits.name: Specialist: Crafting

traits.description: You were a culinary professional or devoted homesteader. +4 to Cooking, Farming, Fishing, and Foraging. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.
traits.name: Specialist: Food

traits.description: A lifelong firearms enthusiast. +4 to Aiming and Reloading. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.
traits.name: Specialist: Firearms

traits.description: Your body is a finely tuned machine. +4 to Sprinting, Nimbleness, Lightfooted, and Sneaking. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.
traits.name: Specialist: Movement

traits.description: You dedicated your pre-apocalypse life to weapons mastery. +4 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, Short Blade, Short Blunt, and Spear. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.
traits.name: Specialist: Weapons

traits.description: You were born to run. Start at Sprinting level 1.
traits.name: Sprint Demon

traits.description: Fatigue accumulates more slowly while running or sprinting.
traits.name: Squirrel

traits.description: You have solid medical training and recover from treated wounds well. +1 to First Aid. Bandaged wounds stop bleeding faster, but unbandaged wounds are unaffected.
traits.name: Staunch

traits.description: +2 to Nimble, +1 to Strength. You do not suffer random falls while climbing fences or intact ropes.
traits.name: Strong and Nimble

traits.description: Sprinting increases unhappiness by 2 every in-game minute.
traits.name: Sunday Runner

traits.description: Your immune system is exceptional. Infections that would lay others low barely register with your body.
traits.name: Super Immune

traits.description: Light on your feet, you move faster than most. +1 to Lightfooted.
traits.name: Swift

traits.description: Lean muscle built through calisthenics. +2 to Fitness.
traits.name: Taut

traits.description: +1 to Small Blunt. Stomping a downed zombie kills it instantly.
traits.name: Tavern Brawler

traits.description: Nothing will stop you. +4 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, Short Blade, Short Blunt, Spear, Aiming, and Reloading.
traits.name: Terminator

traits.description: Your blood clots unusually fast. BleedingTime decays 1.5x faster (wounds clot faster) and active bleed death rate is reduced to 50 percent of normal.
traits.name: Thick Blooded

traits.description: You love taking things apart and putting them back together. +1 to Electrical, Mechanics, Tailoring, and Flint Knapping.
traits.name: Tinkerer

traits.description: Your upper-body bulk makes nimble movement harder. Nimbleness XP gain and base agility are reduced.
traits.name: Top Heavy

traits.description: +2 to Trapping. Your traps never lose condition from use.
traits.name: Trackman

traits.description: +1 to Fitness and Sprinting. Walking does not drain endurance, and the extra walking calorie burn is reduced back to the normal passive rate.
traits.name: Trekker

traits.description: You favour weapons that require both hands. +2 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, and Spear.
traits.name: Two-Handed

traits.description: +2 to Axe. Two-handed axe attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Two-Handed Axe

traits.description: +2 to Long Blade. Two-handed blade attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Two-Handed Blade

traits.description: +2 to Blunt. Two-handed blunt weapon attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.
traits.name: Two-Handed Blunt

traits.description: Fear never really got its hooks into you. Every 10 in-game minutes, if panic is above 10, panic is reduced by 10.
traits.name: Unwavering

traits.description: A life on the road taught you where to look and what to grab. Chance to find a bonus useful item when looting containers and corpses.
traits.name: Vagabond

traits.description: Getting behind the wheel or into a vehicle fills you with dread. The fear is irrational but it is very real.
traits.name: Vehophobic

traits.description: Active bleeding drains your health at 60 percent of the normal rate. Wound clotting speed is unchanged.
traits.name: Weakly Bleeding Wounds

traits.description: Your mood shifts with the sky. Storms drag you down; clear days lift you up more than they should.
traits.name: Weather Sensitive

traits.description: Foraged plants that others eat without concern leave you feeling ill. Wild food carries real risk for you.
traits.name: Wild Plant Allergy

traits.description: +1 to Plant Scavenging and Fishing. 30 percent more forage yield. Fish you catch weigh 50 percent more and provide 50 percent more nutrition.
traits.name: Wildsman

traits.description: +1 Axe. Grants Ax-pert's 50% bonus tree damage and faster axe attacks. Eligible for the rare pine-tree key ring. Cannot be combined with another source of Ax-pert.
traits.name: Wood Splitter
